name: ROYAL HOLDINGS Co., Ltd.
summary: ROYAL HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates a chain of restaurants in Japan. It operates through Restaurant Business; Contract Business; Hotel Business; Food Business; and Others segments. The company operates restaurants under the Royal Host, TENYA, Sizzler, Shakey's, Royal Garden Cafe, Mrs. Elizabeth Muffin, and Standard Coffee brands; beer restaurants, cafes, and various specialty shops; and hotels under the Richmond Hotel brand.
